releasePlan.notes: Roles: enable-backend-status-error-rate = killswitch; enable-backend-status-latency = monitoring; enable-backend-status-success-rate = monitoring. These metrics are ONE-ARMED by construction: v1 is a net-new page element, so the control page renders no status line and emits no events. Latency and success-rate therefore have no control arm to compare against and must not gate the release. Error rate is kept as the killswitch because any error volume at all comes from the treatment path. The project has no otel* or $ld:telemetry:* autogenerated metrics to use as global guardrails, and the frontend service has no OpenTelemetry or LaunchDarkly observability SDK installed, so track() is the only valid backing (span_coverage: none). Events are emitted server-side from POST /api/backend-status-event, which the v1 page calls via navigator.sendBeacon; that route is unauthenticated.
